detail: UX-B-04 — IMPLEMENTED. The section box was stale (children reached x=3980 in a 3280-wide box, which is what made add-state-board compute a NaN slot); widened to 4520x4432 to contain them before placing.

UX-B-06 — IMPLEMENTED (board), DOOR OWED. Board 2898:12617 'Pages · tree · drag · drop indicator' created in section 1776:8377 from its planned source and read back with no overlap. It has NO inbound edge: the plan named the hotspot's own name but never the label that triggers this state, and a hotspot pointing at the wrong label is worse than none — wire-edges walking to the nearest frame would make the whole panel clickable. Owed: one add-hotspots row per state naming its trigger.
